2125412404838170807.en_summary: @steve_hanke says Nvidia's 70% operating margins are too good to be true. Prof. Aswath Damodaran warns “The 70 cannot stay 70.”
2125412404838170807.zh_summary: @steve_hanke 指 Nvidia 70% 的營運利潤率好得不真實。Aswath Damodaran 教授警告「70 不能保持 70」。

ticker_notes.NVDA: 70% 營運利潤率不可持續，Damodaran 警告

2125411655978774954.en_summary: @greg_ip says if Nvidia issues equity to Trump/U.S., it would become even more of a GSE than the original GSEs, aligning federal incentives more tightly towards Nvidia's profits rather than national security.
2125411655978774954.zh_summary: @greg_ip 指如果 Nvidia 向特朗普/美國發行股權，它將比原來的 GSE 更像 GSE，並使聯邦激勵更緊密對齊 Nvidia 的利潤而非國家安全。

2125409890713903341.en_summary: @CKCapitalxx says SpaceX is starting to look really interesting in the $120s. Recalls Morgan Stanley piece in July: at $100 market pricing in rockets and Starlink alone, zero for AI. At these levels small premium over AI worth nothing. Revenue from ~$10B in 2023 to nearly $19B last year, launch cadence climbing, Starlink compounding.
2125409890713903341.zh_summary: @CKCapitalxx 指 SpaceX 在 120 美元附近開始看起來很有趣。回憶摩根士丹利七月文章：100 美元時市場只定價火箭和 Starlink，AI 為零。現在水平只是 AI 一文不值的小幅溢價。收入從 2023 年約 100 億升至去年近 190 億，發射節奏上升，Starlink 複合增長。

ticker_notes.SPCX: 在 120 美元有趣，收入快速增長，AI 價值低定價
